# PathSnap - results tables (auto-generated by scripts/report_tables.py)

Every value is read from files in `outputs/`. Re-run the script after re-running experiments.

## 3.1 Overall model comparison (student-test unless stated)

| Model | Algorithm family | Key configuration | CV macro F1 (5-fold, mean ± std) | Top-1 accuracy | Route continuity | Student-test macro F1 | Log loss | Inference time (164,601 candidate rows) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| HistGradientBoosting | Boosting | lr=0.1, max_iter=300, max_leaf_nodes=31, early stopping | 0.9135 ± 0.0239 | 0.8637 (+HMM 0.9534) | 0.9257 (+HMM 0.9832) | 0.9195 | 0.0866 | 0.202 s |
| Random Forest | Bagging ensemble | 150 trees, min_samples_leaf=10, max_features=sqrt | 0.9137 ± 0.0238 | 0.8640 (+HMM 0.9496) | 0.9274 (+HMM 0.9830) | 0.9195 | 0.0811 | 0.860 s |
| MLP | Neural network | hidden=(64,32), relu, adam lr=1e-3, batch=512, early stopping | 0.9095 ± 0.0251 | 0.8638 (+HMM 0.9457) | 0.9330 (+HMM 0.9828) | 0.9194 | 0.0831 | 0.112 s |
| Gaussian Naive Bayes | Probabilistic | var_smoothing=1e-9, standardised inputs | 0.7074 ± 0.0198 | 0.8208 (+HMM 0.9310) | 0.9151 (+HMM 0.9813) | 0.6774 | 2.3861 | 0.043 s |
| Logistic Regression | Linear | L2, C=1.0, lbfgs, max_iter=1000, standardised inputs | 0.8941 ± 0.0198 | 0.8476 (+HMM 0.9119) | 0.9218 (+HMM 0.9827) | 0.8991 | 0.1189 | 0.017 s |

Rows are ordered by the selection metric (top-1 after HMM). CV = 5-fold GroupKFold over the 78 usable training trips. Top-1 / continuity: classifier only, then after HMM/Viterbi (beta = 2 m). Log loss is applicable to all five (all output probabilities).

## 4 Bayesian hyperparameter optimisation (HistGradientBoosting)

| Hyperparameter | Type | Low | High | Prior | Best value |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| learning_rate | float | 0.02 | 0.3 | log | 0.02007 |
| max_iter | int | 100 | 600 | uniform | 600 |
| max_leaf_nodes | int | 15 | 127 | log | 28 |
| min_samples_leaf | int | 20 | 400 | log | 20 |
| l2_regularization | float | 0.0001 | 10 | log | 0.2431 |
| max_features | float | 0.5 | 1 | uniform | 0.5272 |

Sampler: TPE (Optuna), seed 42. Objective: mean observation top-1 accuracy, 3-fold GroupKFold over training trips, 200,000 rows per fold. Fixed: early_stopping=True, validation_fraction=0.1, random_state=42. Trials: 30, best trial #27 (CV top-1 0.8527). Tuning cost: 766 s.

| Model | CV macro F1 | Student-test top-1 | Student-test macro F1 | Log loss | Inference time | Fit time | Boosting rounds used |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| untuned | 0.9135 ± 0.0239 | 0.8637 | 0.9195 | 0.0866 | 0.204 s | 2.6 s | 81 |
| tuned | 0.9149 ± 0.0244 | 0.8694 | 0.9219 | 0.0791 | 1.364 s | 14.8 s | 600 |
